top_5_citable.heading: Does CCC offer fixed pricing?
top_5_citable.label: Low Citability
top_5_citable.preview: Some services are offered as fixed-scope assessments or defined packages. Larger engagements are priced after discovery establishes the requirements, risks, dependencies, and client responsibilities.

top_5_citable.heading: What types of Salesforce organizations does CCC support?
top_5_citable.label: Low Citability
top_5_citable.preview: CCC works with nonprofit, government, healthcare, and enterprise teams. The best fit is an organization that values direct senior involvement, clear documentation, and accountable delivery.

top_5_citable.heading: Does CCC only work on AI projects?
top_5_citable.label: Low Citability
top_5_citable.preview: No. AI readiness is a central practice area. CCC also supports Salesforce architecture, data governance, implementation oversight, documentation, and training when that work strengthens long-term control.

bottom_5_citable.heading: Can CCC work with an internal Salesforce team?
bottom_5_citable.label: Poor Citability
bottom_5_citable.preview: Yes. CCC can lead an assessment, support an internal administrator, provide architecture oversight, review existing work, or fill a defined advisory gap.

bottom_5_citable.heading: Can CCC help prepare Salesforce for Agentforce?
bottom_5_citable.label: Poor Citability
bottom_5_citable.preview: Yes. CCC can review data quality, access controls, automation, documentation, knowledge sources, human-review requirements, and governance before an Agentforce implementation moves into production.
